verdict.rationale: Probes show https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and indexes the full Grok Build docs section. It also documents a markdown convention: append .md or send Accept: text/markdown. A keyless runtime GET of build/overview.md returned the clean markdown mirror, and an OpenAPI spec is also served. The .md.md 404 only reflects a doubled extension and does not contradict this. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of users actually pointing agents at these docs.
